turns.replyTail:
Spoon Support · AI

Marley Spoon Support · AI says:

Yes. You may change the delivery address if the order is before the cutoff and not yet in progress:

Open Orders.
Find the order and select Change under the address.
Choose the new address and save.

The cutoff is typically 6–7 days before delivery, depending on your location. Afterward, account changes are unavailable. A brand-new first order may also be canceled or rescheduled before the cutoff.
